application.source: classification mapping required by the facts audit brief

cells_liion.note: This package is lead-acid; a lithium-ion cell count does not apply.

cells_leadacid.note: The paper gives the battery as 326 kWh rated capacity and 90 kW maximum (p. 3) but no cell count; the release has system-level signals only.

cell_channels_measured.note: Released tables contain system-level battery measurements, not individual cell channels.

obs_hours.note: Observation-hours are not used when calendar spans are measurable or no cadence is available.

fault_onset_timestamp.source: docs/descriptor/TABLE3_faults.md; released labels and metadata contain no explicit fault-onset timestamp field

sentinels_documented.note: Error code -999,999 on and before the maintenance days (14 Nov 2015, 19 Nov 2016, 18 Nov 2017) and on other days; battery DC voltage 0 on maintenance days; DC current between -680 and -450 A out of range; all blanked in the cleaned files (paper p. 6-7). Raw files hold 1,243,210 values of -999,999 and no +999,999 (scripts/checks/source_audit/tsukuba_tumftm_ppl/check_tsukuba_audit.py).
